name: burn_states
note: Bench only: walks a board through every state of the five-hour burn view (docs/plans/burn-5h.md) without spending quota. Kept out of tests/fleet/scenarios, which the fleet agent runs as release scenarios. Each state holds for a minute; the burn line follows a change within about 17 s (15 s floor plus a fast tick). At 360 s the account gets a session window back, the gauge returns and the burn line stops; at 420 s it goes away again and the view comes back. Run it: BLINK_SCENARIO=tests/fleet/bench/burn_states.json python3 claude_usage_bridge.py --port PORT
